sentences.text: For burns, cool the area under cool running water for ten to twenty minutes, then cover it loosely with a clean dressing.
Don’t use ice, butter or ointments.
For a suspected fracture, immobilize the limb in the position you found it, and check circulation beyond the injury.
If you suspect a head, neck or back injury, such as from a fall in rough seas, keep the person still and don’t move them unless they’re in danger.
For something in the eye, don’t rub it; flush with clean water.
And always write down what happened and what you did, both for the medical team and for your casualty report.
